field.label: Enable intelligence history and analytics
field.help: Collect snapshots for forecasts, gateway quality, anomalies and the completed-cycle archive. Reporting works without it, but history and forecasts need it.

field.label: Analytics retention (days)
field.help: How long snapshots are kept. Longer history makes anomaly baselines and cycle comparisons more meaningful.

field.label: Anomaly sensitivity (standard deviations)
field.help: Lower values detect more deviations. Three is a conservative default.

field.label: Device groups (JSON)
field.help: Array of objects with name, members (IP/CIDR list), and optional budget_gb.

field.label: Per-device policies (JSON)
field.help: Array of objects with address, optional budget_gb, and exclude true/false.
